attributes.board_name: Utah Division of Professional Licensing (DOPL), Board of Nursing

rules.accepted_credit_types: Approved continuing education per R156-31b (e.g. nationally recognized health-education approvers, nursing programs, accredited coursework, other state boards of nursing)
rules.alternatives: Three options in the 2 years before renewal: 30 contact hours of approved CE; or 400 hours of licensed practice; or 200 hours of licensed practice plus 15 contact hours of approved CE.

topics.who: All RN/LPN renewals: view the suicide prevention video under Utah Code 58-1-601 and submit proof

rules.notes: Two-year renewal cycle; the renewal date is set in rule R156-1-308a, whose official text could not be read, so the date is not recorded. DOPL pages block automated reading.
rules.legal_basis: Utah Admin. Code R156-31b-303(3)(a); Utah Code 58-31b-305
rules.rule_quote: (a) An LPN or RN shall complete one of the following during the two-year period immediately preceding the date of application for renewal: (i) licensed practice for not less than 400 hours; (ii) licensed practice for not less than 200 hours and completion of 15 contact hours of approved continuing education; or (iii) completion of 30 contact hours of approved continuing education hours.
